description: TI TPS54331DDAR DDA PowerPAD on a separate, non-drilled land pattern for standard PCB fabrication.
name: tps54331-dda-no-vip

provenance.source: TI SLVS839H pp. 35–37 (4202561/F, 4206322-5/L, 4208951-5/D); STEP copied unchanged from tps54331@0.1.0

watch_out_for: Solder pad 9 to GND. TI SLVS839H §8.4.1 permits adjacent thermal vias. Requires externally stitched solid ground planes; pad 9 contains no drills and needs no filled-via process. Center paste aperture follows the 0.127 mm stencil example. No assembled thermal performance is claimed.
